title:
What stays after
the last page?
subtitle: Meet Readmory. Your personal reading space.
voice: Ever finish an amazing book and wonder—what actually stays with you after the last page? Meet Readmory! It’s the personal reading space built to turn every book you read, and every highlight you save, into a living collection of ideas.

title: Your Kobo library, ready to explore
subtitle: Connect by USB. Choose your folder or files. Review and import.
voice: Getting started with your Kobo library is a breeze! Just plug in your e-reader via USB, pick your device folder or files, and check out your instant import snapshot. In one click, your books, annotations, and reading history land right on your digital shelf—ready to explore!

title: My Library
subtitle: Kobo and KOReader progress, reflections, and captured passages.
voice: Welcome to My Library! Here, your entire reading life comes to life visually, tracking your progress across Kobo and KOReader. Searching for a favorite title? Type it in and jump right into the details. Open up Taipei Story to compare reading progress across devices, jot down fresh reflections, and scroll through a clean feed of every single quote, bookmark, and note you captured along the way!

title: Statistics
subtitle: Reading hours, active days, and finished books. Estimates stay labeled.
voice: Curious about your reading momentum? Dive into Statistics to see your total hours, active days, and finished books broken down by year and month—with estimated times always clearly marked.

title: Reading Rhythm
subtitle: Your reading calendar, with sessions behind each active day.
voice: Want to zoom in even closer? Reading Rhythm maps out your daily streak on an interactive calendar. Just click any active day to uncover the exact reading sessions and times behind your routine!

title: Knowledge Library
subtitle: Highlights across your books. Search a phrase to find the passage.
voice: Now for the magic: your Knowledge Library! Every highlight from every book lives right here in one powerhouse feed. Scroll through your favorite passages for quick inspiration, or punch a half-remembered phrase into the search bar to pull up the exact quote and your personal notes in a split second!

title: Personal Notes
subtitle: Your thoughts, with the original passage one click away.
voice: In Personal Notes, your own thoughts take the spotlight. Filter by book and expand the original passage with a single click so you never lose the context behind your big ideas.

title: Private by design
subtitle: No accounts or tracking. Browser storage with a portable backup.
voice: Best of all, Readmory is one hundred percent private by design. No accounts, no tracking, and no cloud uploads—your data stays right in your browser, and you can export a portable backup anytime!

title: Readmory
subtitle: Your reading, remembered.
voice: Readmory. Your reading, remembered. Jump into the open-source public beta today!
